description: Run a coordinated swarm of coding agents: one Mayor thread plans work in a Beads ledger and slings each task to a worker in its own worktree. Verified work lands as a pushed branch with its bead moved to review, and merges stay yours. Adversarial reviews run lite or one-reviewer-per-lens with confidence-rated findings, and other people's pull requests come back with a drafted approve, comment, or request-changes response. A Town Hall board shows every bead blocked, ready, in flight, or in review, and scheduled patrols sweep for cruft and security issues. Requires BB 0.49+, the Beads CLI (bd) on the BB host, git, and an authenticated GitHub CLI.
